title: Cthulhu pub
description:
Cthulhu pub is a pub simulator with Lovecraft universe lore. 

In Cthulhu pub, you can build your own pub or restaurant. Create cute characters and creepy monsters and establish a small pub or make a large cafe with many options. 

Game features: 

• Build walls and floors for your pub!

• Build tables and kitchen appliances.

• Set decorations.

• Hire your staff: cooks, chefs, cleaners, and waitresses.

• Hire warriors who will protect your pub.

• Discover new recipes for the kitchen.

• Grow your food.

• Earn billions with your Cthulhu pub!
description_short: In Cthulhu pub, you can build your own pub or restaurant. Create cute characters, creepy monsters and establish a small cute pub or make a large castle with monsters, humans, and ancient Gods.
